variant: iCalendar recurrence across a DST gap
applicability: The gap policy follows the RFC recurrence rule. Use America/New_York data that includes the 2007 spring transition.
law: A generated nonexistent local occurrence is dropped and does not consume COUNT.
edge_cases: The generated 2007-03-11 02:30 local time is in the DST gap.

oracle.derivation: Use the gap documented in RFC 5545 section 3.3.5 and the skip-and-do-not-count rule in 3.3.10. Confirm existence of each wall time by a round trip via UTC with zoneinfo.

known_wrong_implementations: Skip the occurrence but charge it against COUNT.
